primary.title: Primary Fee
primary.description: The required monthly fee for the property.
primary.note: Each property can have only one primary fee.

monthly.title: Monthly Fee
monthly.description: A fee that is charged every month.
monthly.rule: You can choose how many times it should be applied to the property.

oneTime.title: One-Time Fee
oneTime.rule: The <u>active</u> fee is included in the current charge.
oneTime.note: Deactivate it when it <u>should no longer</u> be charged.

forFund.title: Fund Fee
forFund.description: A fee used to set aside money for a fund.
forFund.rule: Each property can contribute a different amount to the fund.
forFund.note: The fund can be used for <u>planned</u> or <u>unexpected</u> expenses.

monthlyFeeInfo: Determines whether the fee is charged monthly or once.
addAtLeastOneHome: Please add at least ONE property
selectAtLeastOneHome: Please select at least ONE property
homeFeeAlreadyPrimary: One or more selected properties already have a primary fee
primaryMustBeMonthly: The primary fee must be monthly

primaryFeeInfo.title: Primary Fee
primaryFeeInfo.description:
The primary fee is applied monthly and is calculated based on the number of
active residents in the property.

example.title: Each property has its own <u>primary</u> fee
example.description: The primary fee can be different for each property.

important.title: Important
important.onePerProperty: Each property can have only one primary fee.
important.activeResidents: The calculation includes the owner (if active) and all active residents.
important.differentProperties: Different properties can have different primary fees.

primaryFeeConfirmation.title: Set Primary Fee
primaryFeeConfirmation.question:
Are you sure you want this fee
to be set as the primary fee?
primaryFeeConfirmation.description: The primary fee is calculated based on the number of active residents in the property. Each property can have only one primary fee.

fundInfo.title: Set This Fee as a Fund Fee
fundInfo.description: An amount that is set aside for future expenses or needs.
fundInfo.rule: Each property can have a different amount contributed to the fund.
fundInfo.note: It can be used for <u>planned</u> or <u>unexpected</u> expenses.

fundFee.rule: Each property can have only one fee for each fund.
fundFee.note: The fee is included in the current charge.

billInfo.title: How Do Bills Work?
billInfo.description: Add recurring condominium bills once, and they will automatically appear every month.

steps.add: Add a name, for example: "Electricity", "Water", or "Elevator".
steps.monthly: The bill is created and displayed every month.
steps.value: Only the amount needs to be entered when the bill is paid.

billInfo.note: You can edit or delete added bills at any time.
